instantiated_cells.cited_section: Ohio Rev. Code §§101.99(A)–(B) (penalties for violations of §101.71 and §101.77); §121.99(A)–(B) (penalties for violations of §121.61 and §121.67)
instantiated_cells.justification: The lobbying-disclosure statutes expressly make failures to register/keep records/file required statements and filing false statements criminal misdemeanors, establishing statutory penalties for disclosure violations.

The statutes authorize the attorney general to investigate compliance and refer apparent violations for prosecution, but they do not require regular or periodic auditing/compliance audits of lobbying disclosure records by an independent third party.
